title: Multi-Agent Off-Policy Deep Reinforcement Learning for Smart Campus Coverage
abstract: arXiv:2608.19049v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has recently gained a great attention due to its real-time adaptation and effectiveness in complex optimization problems. This paper investigates the optimal deployment of millimeter-wave (mmWave) base stations (BSs) in a realistic, non-convex campus topology. The optimization problem is NP-hard, due to the non-convex, non-smooth nature of the max-min fairness objective. To overcome these constraints, we formulate the BS placement as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) and systematically benchmark four DRL schemes: a discrete single-agent Deep Q-Network (DQN), a spatially partitioned Multi-Agent DQN, a continuous single-agent Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG), and a geographically partitioned multi-agent DDPG framework. translated_title: 面向智慧校园覆盖的多智能体离策略深度强化学习
translated_abstract: 深度强化学习（DRL）因其在复杂优化问题中的实时适应性和有效性而受到广泛关注。本文研究了在现实、非凸的校园拓扑中毫米波（mmWave）基站（BS）的最优部署问题。由于最大最小公平性目标的非凸、非平滑特性，该优化问题为NP难问题。为克服这些约束，我们将基站布局建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），并系统性地评估了四种DRL方案：离散单智能体深度Q网络（DQN）、空间分区多智能体DQN、连续单智能体深度确定性策略梯度（DDPG）以及地理分区多智能体DDPG框架。数值评估表明，在密集场景下，多智能体DDPG方法显著优于单智能体方法。此外，实现了完全覆盖，并获得了公平的Jain指数。
tldr: 本文提出并验证了多智能体DDPG框架在智慧校园毫米波基站部署中的优越性，实现了完全覆盖和公平性优化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes and validates a multi-agent DDPG framework for mmWave base station deployment in smart campus, achieving full coverage and fairness optimization.
